text:
maria: Opening a small PR to unify SOC2 audit-log copy and add a short migration page for audit_schema v2. Need: short SDK snippets (Go/Node/Python), a representative export JSON example that includes the new fields, and legal-approved retention wording before the release branch cut.

alex: Can you paste the v2 highlights?

maria: Sure: event_type -> audit_event.category, added service.context.*, timestamps normalized to ISO8601, retention_hint metadata, and a legal_hold boolean under metadata. Internal diff: https://internal.redwood/audit/schema/v2-diff (internal).

sanjay: I'll draft the migration mapping table (old_field -> new_field) and a curl export example. Will include a jq validation line.

alex: Draft Go snippet for docs (very small):
```go
// find audit events with retention hint
res, err := client.Audit.List(ctx, AuditListParams{From: fromISO, To: toISO, RetentionHint: "90d"})
if err != nil { return err }
fmt.Println(len(res.Items))
```

alex: Draft Node snippet:
```js
// query audit with retention hint
const res = await client.audit.list({ from: isoFrom, to: isoTo, retentionHint: '90d' })
console.log(res.items.length)
```

sanjay: Python snippet draft:
```py
# audit export with retention hint
res = client.audit.list(from=iso_from, to=iso_to, retention_hint='90d')
print(len(res['items']))
```

sanjay: Curl export example (returns export.json):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/audit/export?from=2025-01-01T00:00:00Z&to=2025-01-02T00:00:00Z" -o export.json
```

alex: Add this jq snippet to the export example so readers can sanity-check fields: `jq '.items[] | {timestamp: .timestamp, category: .audit_event.category, service: .service.context.name, kv: .request.kv_cache_id, legal_hold: .metadata.legal_hold}' export.json`

jen: Legal-approved retention phrasing to use verbatim: "Retention is configurable per customer account; the default retention period is 90 days. Exported audit records may be retained when required by law or legal process." Also, please replace all occurrences of "customer" with "customer account" to match the glossary.

maria: Good. I'll update the PR copy. Two small asks: (1) include an example JSON export object that shows audit_event.category and service.context, and (2) add a redirect from /docs/audit-log -> /docs/audit/schema-v2/export to prevent link rot.

sanjay: Migration table note: if seq_id or kv_cache_id is missing in older exports, map previous sequence_id -> service.context.kv_cache_id and set audit_event.category from event_type. I'll include that mapping snippet.

infra: FYI infra team needs a changelog line; export format change requires a minor bump to the export agent. Tagging infra release owners and please coordinate release windows.

docs-bot: PR #5012 opened by maria: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5012 :bookmark_tabs:

alex: I'll push a tiny commit to polish code fence language tags and the example export JSON.

jen: I'll run a final legal sweep tonight; if the wording change is applied (customer -> customer account) I can approve.

maria: Thanks all. Plan: ship PR with snippets, example JSON, redirect, and changelog entry. Merge after QA + legal sign-off. :thumbsup:
